settings.title: AI models
settings.description: Let {{product}} write study plans and explanations with a model you choose. Nothing is sent to an AI service until you set one up and read what it receives.
settings.empty: No model set up yet. Add an API key, or use a model on this computer.

local.title: Models on this computer
local.hint: {{product}} looks for Ollama and LM Studio running on this computer. It never downloads a model for you.
local.detecting: Looking for model servers on this computer…
local.detectFailed: Couldn't check for model servers on this computer.
local.notRunning: Not running. Start it, then look again.

problem.key_missing: The key is missing from your keychain. Replace it to use this service again.
problem.model_missing: A model you chose is no longer offered. Choose another below.
problem.disclosure_changed: What this service receives has changed since you last read it.

backend.removeBody: {{product}} deletes the key from your keychain and stops using {{name}} for every feature. Your usage history stays.

training.may_train: may be used for training (you can turn this off)
training.may_train_free_tier: free tier: may be used for training
training.unknown: training unknown: check the provider's terms

disclosure.title: Before {{product}} uses {{name}}
disclosure.intro: This is what happens when {{product}} uses this service. If any of it changes, {{product}} asks you again.
disclosure.changed: This changed since you last read it.

gai.heading: {{product}} uses generative AI
gai.body: When you ask for a study plan or an explanation, {{product}} writes it with a generative AI model. Everything it writes is labelled AI-generated, with the service, the model and the date.

sent.heading: What is sent, and to whom
sent.structure: Course structure: titles, dates, deadlines and week numbers.
sent.material_text: Text from your course materials (slides, notes), for explanations and course calendars, only from courses whose rules allow it.
sent.cloud: It goes to {{name}} and is handled under {{name}}'s terms.
sent.onDevice: It goes to {{name}} on this computer and doesn't leave it.

training.heading: Training and storage
training.no_training: {{name}} doesn't use what {{product}} sends to train its models.
training.may_train: {{name}} may use what's sent to train its models, depending on your account setting.
training.may_train_free_tier: On {{name}}'s free tier, what's sent may be used to improve its products, and people may review it. A key with billing turned on avoids this.
training.unknown: {{product}} doesn't know whether this service trains on what's sent. Check its terms before you continue.

retention.stored_days_one: {{name}} may keep what's sent for up to {{count}} day, for example to detect abuse.
retention.stored_days_other: {{name}} may keep what's sent for up to {{count}} days, for example to detect abuse.
retention.provider_terms: How long {{name}} keeps what's sent depends on its terms.
retention.on_device: Nothing is stored outside this computer.

admin.heading: Who else can see it
admin.body: If your account belongs to a school or an employer, its administrators may be able to see what's sent.

cost.heading: Cost
cost.api_billing: Each run is billed to your API account. {{product}} shows an estimate before each run and keeps to a monthly budget you set.
cost.plan_credits: Runs count toward your plan's usage limits. Past them, credits may be used.
cost.free_on_device: Runs on this computer are free. They use its memory and battery.
cost.cloud_via_local: This model runs in the cloud through {{name}}, not on this computer. {{name}}'s terms and limits apply.

age.heading: Age
age.body: {{name}} requires you to be {{age}} or older.
age.guardian: {{name}} requires you to be {{age}} or older, and under 18 you need a parent's or guardian's permission.

freeTier.confirm: I understand that on the free tier, what's sent may be used to improve {{name}}'s products and reviewed by people.

limits.heading: Limitations and risks
limits.body: AI can be wrong, leave things out, or sound more certain than it should. Check what it writes against your slides and readings. It doesn't replace your instructor's rules: you remain responsible for following each course's AI policy.

ownership.heading: Who owns the materials
ownership.body: Your course materials, and anything derived from them, including what AI writes from them, remain your institution's and your instructors'.

disclosure.confirmFirst: Tick the confirmation above to turn it on.

addKey.title: Add an API key
addKey.description: Use your own key from an AI provider. {{product}} keeps it in your system's keychain and only ever shows its last 4 characters.
addKey.baseUrlHint: The endpoint's base address, like https://llm.example.edu/v1
addKey.keyHint: {{product}} checks it with a free call to the provider before saving it.
addKey.codingPlan: {{product}} can't use this key: it's from a coding plan, which the provider allows only in its own coding tools.

features.title: Which model does what
features.hint: A small, cheap model is enough for plans and notes. Explanations read your materials and do better with a stronger one.
features.noPriceNote: {{product}} has no price for {{model}}, so your budget can't be enforced for it. You'll be asked to confirm before its first run.
features.thinkingNote: {{model}} always thinks before it answers, which costs more.
features.cloudNote: {{model}} runs in the cloud, not on this computer.
features.turnOnFirst: Turn on a model above to choose it here.

budget.title: Monthly budget for API keys
budget.hint: {{product}} checks each run's estimate against it and asks before going over. It's a safety net, not a hard limit: also set a spending limit in your provider's dashboard.
budget.warn: You've used {{percent}}% of this month's budget.

removeAll.hint: Deletes your keys, model choices, usage history and everything {{product}} wrote with AI.
removeAll.title: Remove all AI data?
removeAll.body: This deletes your API keys from the keychain, your model choices, the usage history, the AI settings, and every plan and explanation {{product}} wrote. Your courses, their rules and your answers about sharing materials stay.

usage.title: AI usage
usage.description: Counted on this computer: runs, tokens and estimated cost. Only the counts are kept, never what was sent.
usage.caption: AI usage in {{month}}
usage.estimatedNote: ≈ includes estimates (for example, a cancelled run).

estimate.label: Estimated cost:
estimate.cloudNoPrice: Runs in the cloud; no cost estimate
estimate.details: Up to {{input}} tokens in and {{output}} out
estimate.useUnpricedHint: Your budget isn't enforced for this model. Its runs are still counted in tokens.
estimate.overBudget: This would go over this month's budget.
estimate.overrideBudget: Go over the budget this time

blocked.course_policy_prohibited: This course's rules say no AI, so {{product}} won't send anything from it.
blocked.course_ai_turned_off: You turned AI off for this course's materials.
blocked.no_readable_materials: This week has no materials {{product}} can read.
blocked.material_sharing_not_allowed: You said this course's materials may not be shared with AI services, so nothing was sent.
blocked.coding_plan_key: This key is from a coding plan, which {{product}} can't use.
blocked.disclosure_not_acknowledged: Read what this service receives, then turn it on.
blocked.no_model_chosen: Choose a model for this in Settings → AI models.
blocked.budget_reached: This would go over this month's budget.
blocked.price_unknown_not_acknowledged: {{product}} has no price for this model. Confirm to use it without a budget.
blocked.weekly_run_cap_reached: You've reached this week's run limit.
blocked.backend_disabled_in_this_build: This service isn't available in this version of {{product}}.

modelError.billing_or_quota: The provider says your account is out of credit or over its quota.

modelError.runtime_outdated: The program this service needs is too old. Update it.
modelError.unsupported: This model can't do what {{product}} needs.

sharing.title: Sharing materials with AI services
sharing.question: Can this course's materials (slides, notes) be shared with an AI service?
sharing.hint: Check your syllabus or ask your instructor. This is separate from whether AI use is allowed in the course.

optionHint.allowed: {{product}} may send text from this course's materials to the AI service you chose.
optionHint.not_sure: {{product}} still sends material text; each result notes where it went.
optionHint.not_allowed: {{product}} never sends this course's materials to a cloud service. A model on this computer still works.

sharing.unanswered: Not answered yet. The first time {{product}} sends this course's materials to an AI service, it reminds you to check.

reminder.title: Check whether your instructor allows sharing course materials with AI services
reminder.body: {{product}} sent text from {{course}}'s materials to {{service}}. If you're not sure it's allowed, check the syllabus or ask your instructor.
reminder.answer: Is sharing this course's materials allowed?

notAllowed.title: Not sent to an AI service
notAllowed.body: You said {{course}}'s materials may not be shared with AI services, so {{product}} sent nothing.
notAllowed.useLocal: Use a model on this computer
notAllowed.structureOnly: Get an overview from the course structure only
